claim: For the same-field two-factor SO3 spin tensor with index-two Tits class, restriction of the split four-dimensional tensor-spin module from a finite splitting extension cannot itself give a K3-type carrier when the target Hodge cocharacter acts identically on all conjugate copies: the real or Hermitian trace polarization has at least four positive directions, whereas K3 type has exactly two.
quantifiers: E=Q(sqrt(5)), beta as in RESULT.txt, any finite field L/E splitting beta, the scalar-restriction tensor-spin carrier whose full G-action preserves its polarization, and the transported target cocharacter interface.
limitations: Does not rule out a different representation, abelian carrier, or non-K3 geometry; no novelty claim.
falsifier: An odd local splitting degree at p2, or a G-invariant polarization on the scalar-restricted module with only two directions in the minority sign despite the active (2,2) blocks.

claim: For a product of K3 surfaces with full product RM Hodge group, a rationally simple Hodge substructure H with total SO3 highest-weight height M(H)=sum_{i,sigma} j_{i,sigma} is in geometric coniveau p whenever M(H)<=d-p, conditional on ordinary rational HC for K3 products and the exact k=1 KS return maps.
quantifiers: Finite K3 product X, rationally simple H subset H^{2d}(X,Q), full product RM Hodge group as stated, integer p>=0, and M(H)<=d-p.
premises: ordinary rational HC for all finite K3 products
algebraic KS right inverse R_{S,1} for every K3 surface
limitations: Representation-height inequality is an explicit hypothesis, not derived from Hodge coniveau. The critical different-quaternion cross orbit has M=2 and d-p=1.
falsifier: A target satisfying the premises and M<=d-p for which the stated rational Hom or support-codimension computation fails.

claim: For E=Q(sqrt(5)), quaternion classes ramified at {sigma1,p2} and {sigma1,p3} have nonzero index-two sum beta ramified at p2,p3, obstructing the E-rank-four tensor-spin form used by the common-class auxiliary-K3 construction.
quantifiers: The explicit number field and ramification sets in RESULT.txt; ABHN supplies the quaternion classes.
premises: Tits-algebra interpretation of the spin tensor
limitations: Construction-boundary obstruction only; it does not refute GHC or all algebraic returns. The specific actual-K3 realization is internally argued and not externally reviewed.
falsifier: A rank-four E-form of the tensor-spin representation while beta remains nonzero.
